request.description:
## Endpoint Initialization

## `{{baseUrl}}initializer/selectInitInfo`

he Device Initialization API streamlines the secure establishment of a connection between the VSDC and ZRA’s Smart Invoice backend.

### Body raw(json)

``` json
{
  "status": "success",
  "data": {
    "info1": "value1",
    "info2": "value2"
  },
  "message": "Initialization information retrieved successfully."
}

 ```
